text:
nina_prod: Quick sync  thinking multi-quarter roadmap idea: intent-based routing. requests carry an intent tag (e.g. "legal-redaction", "low-latency", "regulatory-eu") and the policy engine resolves variant + region.

omar_arch: +1 on intent model but we need policy-as-data and a validation layer. can't hardcode routing rules in service code.

vicky_pm: customers (esp enterprise EU) are explicitly asking for region-only model families + audit trail. sales also wants a cost-estimate widget.

tom_sre: ops reality: warm-pool explosion + KV cache fragmentation if we do per-variant routing. need a soft-isolation path.

eli_research: also risk of quality regressions when fallback swaps family. we must have per-intent eval harness.

nina_prod: propose 3-stage rollout: 1) policy engine + metadata registry (intent tagging only), 2) soft isolation (weighted pref routing + burst), 3) reserved pools for Dedicated customers. timeline Q3 -> Q4 -> Q1.

vicky_pm: launch criteria (draft): telemetry accuracy >=99.5% on test traffic, console cost-delta estimator, canary with synthetic+real traffic, documented rollback window.

omar_arch: draft policy schema idea (yaml):
```
- id: eu-pii-redaction
  intent: regulatory-eu
  allowed_families: [redwood-compat, privacy-certified]
  prefer_region: eu-west-1
  fallback: allow_compatible
  throttle: 10rps
```

tom_sre: add fields: capacity_budget: 200conns, prewarm_hint: true. otherwise we'll see cold spikes.

eli_research: eval plan notes: per-intent prompt set, quality threshold defined (custom metric or BLEURT), auto-rollback if weighted quality_drop >3%.

billing-bot: Cost estimate (soft isolation): +12-25% unit cost delta depending on prefix hit rate. full isolation much higher. report: https://billing.redwood/internal/intent-costs.

vicky_pm: product negotiation point: customers want to pin exact variant from Console. infra pushback on complexity. proposed compromise: Console allows pin-to-family + SLA tier for Hosted, exact variant pinning for Dedicated only.

omar_arch: spec requirement: when policies change, KV cache keys must include (model_family, quant, intent) so we don't get silent cache poisoning.

tom_sre: migration runbook bullets: tag x% of traffic, monitor cache_hit & latency, then increase. have circuit-breaker fallback to baseline routing if tail SLO breaks.

nina_prod: action items: omar -> policy schema PR, eli -> eval harness & prompt sets, tom -> prewarm budgeting tool, vicky -> customer comms + pricing page. target internal demo in 4w?

deploy-bot: CI: intent-routing/policy-schema -> staging build 0.89.2, tests running (unit+integration) https://ci.redwood/internal/2222.

nina_prod: quick poll: prioritize soft isolation + policy engine for Q3? :thumbsup: or full isolation now?

participants: thread reactions show majority :thumbsup: for soft isolation.

vicky_pm: note for sales: offer Dedicated pinned-variant as an upsell, Hosted+ gets family-pin + region guardrails.

omar_arch: one more infra constraint: policy evaluation must be sub-ms on hot path. engine should return tiny routing response: {target_family, target_variant_opt, fallback_list, reason_code}. keep it cheap.

tom_sre: will add SLOs per-route and a capacity estimator in Console.

elli_research: will prepare regression thresholds and a daily diff dashboard.

nina_prod: thanks all. i'll update the PRD with these negotiation points and the migration checklist.
